fieldContract.series: Validated native mode families using exact existing observations. recommendedForDefault is false when current price evidence conflicts with the saved quote.
fieldContract.points: entryId references one entry inside boardId. label is display text, level is the native tier identifier, order is ascending configuration order. sourceObservation is an exact copy for review.
fieldContract.dimension: resolution, mode, or quality. Accepted Kling series use mode because the knob also changes output resolution and inference quality.
fieldContract.qualifiedCandidates: Do not connect by default. Configuration mapping remains inferred or incomplete.
fieldContract.priceOnlyEvidence: Creator quotes without a matched quality measurement. score is null and these are never additional points in a measured series.

rules: Connect only points inside one explicit series and boardId. Never discover families by fuzzy name matching.
Do not combine source, task, benchmark version, audio condition, model version, or engine identities.
A line joins observed configurations for orientation. It is not a fitted curve, a continuous quality scale, or a guarantee of improvement.
Keep missing prices unavailable. Do not join an Arena score to an AA or provider quote.
Two measured settings are enough. Never synthesize low, medium, high, max, reasoning effort, or 4K scores.
This research does not refresh or publish the catalog. Review price drift separately before adopting observations.
